title: Hedgehog with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffd27f'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#c97a28'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- body / spines -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='36' ry='28' fill='#7a4a2b'/>
  <polygon points='20,44 28,30 36,42' fill='#5e3520'/>
  <polygon points='34,36 44,22 52,34' fill='#5e3520'/>
  <polygon points='50,32 60,18 66,32' fill='#5e3520'/>
  <polygon points='64,36 74,24 80,40' fill='#5e3520'/>
  <polygon points='76,48 88,42 84,58' fill='#5e3520'/>
  <polygon points='16,58 6,50 14,68' fill='#5e3520'/>
  <!-- spikes lighter tips -->
  <polygon points='28,30 32,36 24,38' fill='#b3763f'/>
  <polygon points='44,22 48,29 38,30' fill='#b3763f'/>
  <polygon points='60,18 63,26 52,26' fill='#b3763f'/>
  <polygon points='74,24 77,31 67,32' fill='#b3763f'/>
  <!-- face -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='66' rx='26' ry='22' fill='#e8b07a'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='24' cy='72' rx='12' ry='9' fill='#f2c99a'/>
  <circle cx='16' cy='72' r='4' fill='#3a2114'/>
  <!-- eyes sparkly -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='60' rx='6' ry='7' fill='#3a2a55'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='6' ry='7' fill='#3a2a55'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='57' r='2.4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='57' r='2.4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='63' r='1.3' fill='#c9b8ff'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='63' r='1.3' fill='#c9b8ff'/>
  <polygon points='37,53 40,56 43,53 41,58 39,58' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <polygon points='47,53 50,56 53,53 51,58 49,58' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='48' r='6' fill='#c98c52'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='48' r='6' fill='#c98c52'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M22 78 Q28 84 34 80' stroke='#8a4a1e' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='70' r='3.5' fill='#f28da0' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='70' r='3.5' fill='#f28da0' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- little feet -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='88' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#8a5228'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='88' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#8a5228'/>
</svg>
